math_notes.LINEAR_LIGHT: result = A + Fac * (2*B - 1)  (B = noise in 0..1 -> offset +-Fac, no sliding)

math_notes.hex: Blender hex fields are gamma-corrected sRGB; ramp colours are stored linear (color_linear_rgba)

unresolved.item: Damage mask ramp: final black-stop position
unresolved.detail: Last legible value 0.343 (index 0 selected, 14:56.5-14:57.1). A jump cut follows at ~14:57.1; from 14:57.2 on stop 1 (0.442) is selected and stop 0 is never shown numerically again. Pixel measurement of the ramp bar after the cut (dashed active-stop line used as a scale reference: 0.442 measured at 0.444) puts the black stop at 0.350 (14:57.4, bar 384 px) and 0.353 (26:32, bar 127 px). The same method on a pre-cut frame with the black stop at 0.351 measured 0.348. Recipe per-frame notes (OCR) list 0.27-0.31 and are not reliable.
unresolved.resolution: spec uses 0.35 (class C); 0.343 is the last frame-legible value. Visually negligible (mask threshold); exposed as 'Damage Amount' in the suggested interface.
